SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN yt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rows_with_catch,
       MIN(fish_date_doy) as min_doy, 
       MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_doy,
       AVG(CASE WHEN anglers > 0 THEN yt::float / anglers ELSE 0 END) as avg_rate
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
